summary: Applied the gate failure field repair by including level in important-entry matching and failure-origin clarification.

items.title: Gate failures are not covered by the specified failure fields
items.rationale: R2 now treats level as an important-entry matching field and as a failure signal for gate/review/final-regression entries. The clarification now states that gate issue-log entries may carry failure signal in level.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[1].desc and clarifications[2].a now include level. src/flow/lib/run-gate.js appendIssueLogFromGateResult writes level without result/status/failureKind.
